Serialize its complete current public functionCallOutput delegation input exactly; exclude reasoning and unrelated tool output. Do not reconstruct the prompt from memory, parent expected strings or shell here-strings. A metadata-only/truncated read is insufficient; fetch complete public outputs before parsing. Write public capture to .novel-creator/local/evidence/<case>-input.json. Invoke installed input capture --capture-file FILE --thread-id CURRENT --turn-id ACTUAL --source delegated --source-thread-id 01a16af6-0d9b-7173-a5f5-c8775f37df18 --evaluation-only --json. Retain the capture result. Use exactly data.text as the exchange user text and include data.input_artifact unchanged; administrative instructions are not story decisions.

Process subsequent simulated director requests through the installed workflows automatically, choosing response, extraction, continuity and authority judgments yourself. Do not receive prepared response text or prepared creative record payloads from the parent. Use local record constructors and production save; sources must resolve exact real current message spans. Preserve all relevant capture kinds, questions/session links and record history. Save before displaying the exact reply with no unsaved suffix or report, no extra memory citation. A normal-filesystem scoped retry is allowed if sandbox hard links are denied; retain IDs and pending payload and never bypass locks. On any product/schema failure preserve the attempted payload, raw errors and checkpoint and stop honestly; do not alter the product's validators or invent a passing result.

For this initial administrative GATE turn, prepare the fixed noncreative response "Evaluation workspace is ready." with no canon or session changes; continuity not_applicable. Save it and display exactly. Store .novel-creator/local/evidence/GATE-report.json with novel absolute path, thread/turn IDs, full save result, manifest digest, available host/model/version (unknown where unavailable), source_type delegated, native_user_input false, novice_evidence false. Store a pointer at outputs/phase22-pointer.json in your task workspace. Retain all future per-turn input/capture/payload/save/report files under local/evidence with case IDs supplied by parent; reports identify record IDs and versions but do not self-award semantic correctness. Reports must include full save result as compact JSON printed to command output so the parent can establish save-before-display ordering. All administration belongs in files and tool output; final response is the saved text only.
Configured manuscript language: en
Case ID: GATE
